description: Use this when the person has agreed what they ate and wants it logged. Logs one entry per food using the reviewed photo estimates, a saved food or recipe by id and grams, or a named estimate with its serving and nutrients. Logging a saved food by grams can replace its usual portion. A correction to food already logged passes replaces, so the original comes off in the same change. Undo removes the log entries and brings back any replaced. eatenAt null is now. Do not use before they've agreed the foods and amounts, or for a meal they're only planning.

eatenAt.description: When they ate, an ISO date-time; null is now.

idempotencyKey.description: A new random id for this change (a UUID). Send the same one again only to retry this exact change.

carbs.description: Grams of carbs in one serving, for an estimate only.

certainty.description: EXACT for a weighed amount or a label, GOOD for a known food at an amount they gave, ROUGH for an amount guessed from a photo.

fat.description: Grams of fat in one serving, for an estimate only.

foodId.description: A saved food or recipe's id, from search_foods; null otherwise.

foodKey.description: A list food's key (usda:…), from search_foods; null otherwise.

grams.description: Grams eaten, with foodId or foodKey.

kcal.description: Calories in one serving, for an estimate only.

name.description: The food's name, for an estimate only.

protein.description: Grams of protein in one serving, for an estimate only.

quantity.description: How many servings, for an estimate only.

serving.description: One serving in words, such as "1 cup", for an estimate only.

foodId.description: One of the recipe's foods, or a food to add (its id or foodKey).

grams.description: Its grams in this meal (0 leaves it out); null with swapTo.

swapTo.description: Another food's id or foodKey to use in its place; null otherwise.

tweaks.description: This meal's changes to a saved recipe; null otherwise.

replaces.description: Logged entries this corrects (their ids, from get_nutrition), taken off in the same change so the original isn't left beside the fix; null adds to the log.

name: log_foods
title: Log a meal
